note: Re-judged 2026-10-16 after the codec move; units changed only by package qualification. RFC 5575 Section 4: "Flow specification components must follow strict type ordering." TestFlowSpecComponentsAscendingOrder adds types 5,12,3,1 and requires the re-parsed wire order 1,3,5,12 (red on insertion-order emission by core writeComponentsSorted); TestFlowSpecJoinsRepeatedTypeIntoOneComponent requires one Type 4 component with exact merged bytes; TestParseFlowSpecRefusesRepeatedComponentType requires ErrFlowSpecDuplicateType from core parseComponents on a repeated type 4, with the merged control accepted.
